scientific_integrity.limitations: Originality is restricted to \(2<b/a\le2m/(m-1)\), the nonmetric negative-type interval, and its critical crossover. Gomi–Tsuji Lemma 5.4 already covers strict monotonicity of the metric subrange, and the homogeneous-join magnitude formula was previously known there. No independent review or exhaustive historical priority determination.
scientific_integrity.scope: Finite equiradial negative-type distance configurations, all \(m\ge3\), all admissible radii and positive scales.

title: Gaussian magnitude monotonicity and a singular centroid crossover for regular-simplex configurations
